newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Esat and Energis sign interconnect agreement.
newsitem.headline: Esat and Energis sign interconnect agreement.

text.p: Irish-based Esat Telecom said on Friday that it had signed an interconnect agreement with British telecommunications company Energis.

Under the terms of the agreement, Energis will distribute fixed telecom traffic originating from Esat Telecom's customers across its national fibre optic network based on synchronous digital hierarchy technology, Esat said in a statement.
The agreement is the first of its kind in Europe between two private telecommunciations companies, Esat said.
Last week Esat Holdings Limited announced that it had completed a $85.4 million funding venture in the U.S.
Of this, $64 million is to be invested developing Esat Telecom's infrastructure, widening its product portfolio and expanding customer care facilities.
Esat Telecom was the first private phone company in Ireland to compete with Telecom Eireann on inland long distance and international business telephone calls.
With corporate customers rising at a rate of 12 per cent per month, Esat Telecom now has in excess of 2,100 customers and employs 105 people.
